q: 我昨天给小狗买___两个玩具。
zh: 我昨天给小狗买了两个玩具。
py: wǒ zuó tiān gěi xiǎo gǒu mǎi le liǎng ge wán jù
en: Yesterday I bought two toys for my puppy.
why: One finished purchase with a counted object: 了 goes right after 买, before 两个. 过 would only say 'have bought at some time', which clashes with the one specific day 昨天.

q: 上个周末她看___三部电影，都很好看。
zh: 上个周末她看了三部电影，都很好看。
py: shàng ge zhōu mò tā kàn le sān bù diàn yǐng dōu hěn hǎo kàn
en: Last weekend she watched three films, and all of them were good.
why: Three films last weekend is a finished, counted event, so 了 follows 看 directly. 着 means the watching is in progress, and 的 or nothing leaves the verb unfinished.

q: 今天早上弟弟在公园里拍___很多小鸟的照片，非常开心。
zh: 今天早上弟弟在公园里拍了很多小鸟的照片，非常开心。
py: jīn tiān zǎo shang dì di zài gōng yuán lǐ pāi le hěn duō xiǎo niǎo de zhào piàn fēi cháng kāi xīn
en: This morning my little brother took lots of photos of birds in the park and was very happy.
why: A bounded event with a large quantity of photos takes 了 right after 拍. 着 would describe ongoing taking, and 的 or 在 cannot mark a completed verb.

q: 老师给我们放___一首很老的歌。
zh: 老师给我们放了一首很老的歌。
py: lǎo shī gěi wǒ men fàng le yī shǒu hěn lǎo de gē
en: The teacher played us a very old song.
why: One song played once is a finished event with a counted object, so 了 sits right after 放. 着 would say the song is still playing; 的 and 呢 cannot follow a verb to show completion.

q: 我们在湖边坐___一个小时，才回家。
zh: 我们在湖边坐了一个小时，才回家。
py: wǒ men zài hú biān zuò le yī ge xiǎo shí cái huí jiā
en: We sat by the lake for an hour before going home.
why: A completed stretch of time takes 了 after the verb, before the duration. 着 makes the sitting a continuing state and 过 means 'have ever sat for an hour', neither of which fits one afternoon by the lake.

q: 昨天晚上他读___那本小说的最后三章，然后才睡觉。
zh: 昨天晚上他读了那本小说的最后三章，然后才睡觉。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang tā dú le nà běn xiǎo shuō de zuì hòu sān zhāng rán hòu cái shuì jiào
en: Last night he read the last three chapters of that novel before going to sleep.
why: Reading three chapters last night is a finished, counted action, so 了 follows 读. 着 would mean he was reading at the same time as something else; 过 is an experience marker and does not suit a specific night.

q: 我养的猫昨晚抓___一只老鼠。
zh: 我养的猫昨晚抓了一只老鼠。
py: wǒ yǎng de māo zuó wǎn zhuā le yī zhī lǎo shǔ
en: My cat caught a mouse last night.
why: One mouse caught on one night: 了 directly after 抓, before 一只. 过 states experience in general and does not suit 昨晚; 着 and 得 do not mark a finished catch.

q: 她唱___两首歌就下台了。
zh: 她唱了两首歌就下台了。
py: tā chàng le liǎng shǒu gē jiù xià tái le
en: She sang two songs and then left the stage.
why: Two songs finished, then the next step: 了 goes right after 唱, before 两首. 着 would mean she was singing at the time, and 的 or 在 cannot close a completed action.

q: 妈妈上星期给我寄___一本书。
zh: 妈妈上星期给我寄了一本书。
py: mā ma shàng xīng qī gěi wǒ jì le yī běn shū
en: Last week Mom sent me a book.
why: One book sent last week is a single completed act, so 了 comes right after 寄. 过 would say Mom has sent books at some point, which ignores the specific week.

q: 去年春天我们在山上种___三棵树。
zh: 去年春天我们在山上种了三棵树。
py: qù nián chūn tiān wǒ men zài shān shàng zhòng le sān kē shù
en: Last spring we planted three trees on the hill.
why: A finished planting of a counted number of trees needs 了 right after 种. 着 would describe the state 'trees stand planted' or an ongoing action, not what we did last spring.

q: 春天来了，天气暖和___。
zh: 春天来了，天气暖和了。
py: chūn tiān lái le tiān qì nuǎn huo le
en: Spring is here and the weather has turned warm.
why: It was not warm before and is now, a change of state, so 了 closes the clause. 着 and 过 cannot report a new situation.

q: 我家的小狗已经三岁___。
zh: 我家的小狗已经三岁了。
py: wǒ jiā de xiǎo gǒu yǐ jīng sān suì le
en: Our puppy is already three.
why: 已经 plus an age says the dog has now reached three, a new situation, so the sentence ends in 了. Without 了 the sentence is left hanging.

q: 学了一年吉他，他终于会弹这首歌___。
zh: 学了一年吉他，他终于会弹这首歌了。
py: xué le yī nián jí tā tā zhōng yú huì tán zhè shǒu gē le
en: After a year of guitar he can finally play this song.
why: 终于 shows he could not before and can now. That new ability is marked by 了 at the end. 过 would mean 'has played it before', and 着 or 的 add nothing here.

q: 电影快要开始___，你怎么还不来？
zh: 电影快要开始了，你怎么还不来？
py: diàn yǐng kuài yào kāi shǐ le nǐ zěn me hái bù lái
en: The film is about to start; why haven't you come yet?
why: 快要 means a change is about to happen and the clause ends in 了. 着, 过 and 的 do not complete that frame.

q: 雨停___，我们去山上看鸟吧。
zh: 雨停了，我们去山上看鸟吧。
py: yǔ tíng le wǒ men qù shān shàng kàn niǎo ba
en: The rain has stopped; let's go up the hill to look at birds.
why: The rain going from falling to stopped is a change, reported with 了 at the end of the clause. 着 and 过 do not say 'it has now stopped', and the suggestion with 吧 depends on that.

q: 我的小兔子长大___，现在比我的手还大。
zh: 我的小兔子长大了，现在比我的手还大。
py: wǒ de xiǎo tù zi zhǎng dà le xiàn zài bǐ wǒ de shǒu hái dà
en: My bunny has grown up and is now even bigger than my hand.
why: Growing up is a change from small to big, so 了 closes 长大. 着 and 过 do not report the result, and 的 would turn it into a modifier.

q: 秋天到了，树叶都黄___。
zh: 秋天到了，树叶都黄了。
py: qiū tiān dào le shù yè dōu huáng le
en: Autumn has come and the leaves have all turned yellow.
why: Leaves going from green to yellow is a change, so 了 ends the clause. Plain 黄 would only describe a colour, and 过 or 地 do not mark a new state.

q: 已经十点___，小猫还没回家。
zh: 已经十点了，小猫还没回家。
py: yǐ jīng shí diǎn le xiǎo māo hái méi huí jiā
en: It's already ten o'clock and the cat still isn't home.
why: 已经 + a clock time says that time has now arrived, so the clause ends in 了. 着, 的 and 过 cannot mark 'it is now ten'.

q: 这只狗我已经养___三年___，它还是不听话。
zh: 这只狗我已经养了三年了，它还是不听话。
py: zhè zhī gǒu wǒ yǐ jīng yǎng le sān nián le tā hái shì bù tīng huà
en: I've had this dog for three years now and it still doesn't listen.
why: 'Have kept it for three years and still do' needs two 了: one after 养 and one at the end. One 了 would make the three years sound over, and 过 would mean 'once kept' and clash with 还是.

q: 去年夏天我在海边住___两个月___，后来就回北京了。
zh: 去年夏天我在海边住了两个月，后来就回北京了。
py: qù nián xià tiān wǒ zài hǎi biān zhù le liǎng ge yuè hòu lái jiù huí běi jīng le
en: Last summer I lived by the sea for two months and then went back to Beijing.
why: 去年夏天 and 后来 close off the period, so only the 了 after the verb is used. A final 了 after 两个月 would claim I am still living there.

q: 他从早上到现在已经弹___三个小时钢琴___，手都累了。
zh: 他从早上到现在已经弹了三个小时钢琴了，手都累了。
py: tā cóng zǎo shang dào xiàn zài yǐ jīng tán le sān ge xiǎo shí gāng qín le shǒu dōu lèi le
en: He has been playing the piano for three hours since this morning, and his hands are tired.
why: 到现在 and 已经 mean the playing has gone on up to now, so 了 after 弹 and 了 at the end. 着 cannot be followed by a duration, and one 了 alone would make it sound finished.

q: 小狗在门口等___你一个下午___，现在还在那儿呢。
zh: 小狗在门口等了你一个下午了，现在还在那儿呢。
py: xiǎo gǒu zài mén kǒu děng le nǐ yī ge xià wǔ le xiàn zài hái zài nà r ne
en: The puppy has waited for you all afternoon and is still there now.
why: 现在还在那儿 shows the waiting is still going on, so two 了: after 等 and at the end. 着|了 is ungrammatical because 着 cannot take a duration, and one 了 would put the waiting wholly in the past.

q: 你看___这部电影就告诉我好不好看。
zh: 你看了这部电影就告诉我好不好看。
py: nǐ kàn le zhè bù diàn yǐng jiù gào su wǒ hǎo bù hǎo kàn
en: Tell me whether it's good as soon as you've seen this film.
why: In 'once A is done, B', 了 sits right after the first verb, before its object, even for a future request. 着 would mean 'while watching', and 在 or 的 cannot follow the verb here.

q: 我们喂___小狗再出门。
zh: 我们喂了小狗再出门。
py: wǒ men wèi le xiǎo gǒu zài chū mén
en: Let's feed the puppy first and then go out.
why: 'Do A first, then B' with 再: 了 after the first verb, before its object. 着 would mean feeding and going out at once, which the 再 sequence rules out.

q: 下___课，我们就去公园看天鹅。
zh: 下了课，我们就去公园看天鹅。
py: xià le kè wǒ men jiù qù gōng yuán kàn tiān é
en: As soon as class is over, we'll go to the park to see the swans.
why: 了 after 下 means 'once class has ended' and triggers the 就 clause; it is used even for a future plan. 着 would suggest class is still going on.

q: 你读___这本书再借给我吧。
zh: 你读了这本书再借给我吧。
py: nǐ dú le zhè běn shū zài jiè gěi wǒ ba
en: Read this book first, then lend it to me.
why: With 再, the first verb carries 了 before its object: 读了这本书再借给我. 读着 would mean reading while lending, which does not make sense.

q: 他昨天下___班就去看电影了。
zh: 他昨天下了班就去看电影了。
py: tā zuó tiān xià le bān jiù qù kàn diàn yǐng le
en: Yesterday he went to a film right after work.
why: In a past 'right after A, B' sequence, 了 follows the first verb 下, and a second 了 closes the sentence. 着 would mean he went while still at work, and 过 is an experience marker.

q: 明天我起___床就去遛狗。
zh: 明天我起了床就去遛狗。
py: míng tiān wǒ qǐ le chuáng jiù qù liù gǒu
en: Tomorrow I'll take the dog for a walk as soon as I get up.
why: 了 here means 'once I'm up' and stays even though the plan is for tomorrow. 起着床 would mean getting up while doing something else.

q: 回到家，我先喝___水再喂猫。
zh: 回到家，我先喝了水再喂猫。
py: huí dào jiā wǒ xiān hē le shuǐ zài wèi māo
en: When I get home I'll have some water first and then feed the cat.
why: 先…再… sequences put 了 after the first verb, before its object, even when they describe a plan. 着 would mean drinking while feeding the cat.

q: 我小时候每个周末都去___山里看鸟。
zh: 我小时候每个周末都去山里看鸟。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou měi ge zhōu mò dōu qù shān lǐ kàn niǎo
en: When I was little I went to the mountains every weekend to watch birds.
why: 每个周末都 makes this a repeated habit, not one finished event, so no 了 even though it is in the past. 去了 would describe a single trip.

q: 爷爷以前每天早上都听___京剧。
zh: 爷爷以前每天早上都听京剧。
py: yé ye yǐ qián měi tiān zǎo shang dōu tīng jīng jù
en: Grandpa used to listen to Peking opera every morning.
why: 每天早上都 marks a routine, and past routines take no 了 (以前 already shows the time). 听了 would present one completed listening session.

q: 他常常在晚上弹___吉他，邻居都习惯了。
zh: 他常常在晚上弹吉他，邻居都习惯了。
py: tā cháng cháng zài wǎn shang tán jí tā lín jū dōu xí guàn le
en: He often plays guitar at night, and the neighbours are used to it.
why: 常常 signals a repeated action, so 弹 has no 了. 习惯了 at the end is a change of state, a different 了 that does belong.

q: 我家的狗平时一天吃___两顿饭。
zh: 我家的狗平时一天吃两顿饭。
py: wǒ jiā de gǒu píng shí yī tiān chī liǎng dùn fàn
en: My dog usually eats two meals a day.
why: 平时 makes this a general pattern, so there is no 了 even though the object is counted. 吃了两顿饭 would report what happened on one particular day.

q: 老师每个星期五都教我们唱___一首新歌，大家都很喜欢。
zh: 老师每个星期五都教我们唱一首新歌，大家都很喜欢。
py: lǎo shī měi ge xīng qī wǔ dōu jiāo wǒ men chàng yī shǒu xīn gē dà jiā dōu hěn xǐ huan
en: Every Friday the teacher taught us a new song, and everyone liked it.
why: 每个星期五都 makes it a recurring event, so no 了 after 唱, even with the counted 一首新歌. 了 would turn it into one finished occasion.

q: 昨天我___去公园，因为下雨了。
zh: 昨天我没去公园，因为下雨了。
py: zuó tiān wǒ méi qù gōng yuán yīn wèi xià yǔ le
en: I didn't go to the park yesterday because it rained.
why: Saying a past action did not happen uses 没 + verb. 不 would express an unwillingness or a rule, and 别 is a command, neither of which reports what happened yesterday.

q: 他还___吃早饭，肚子很饿。
zh: 他还没吃早饭，肚子很饿。
py: tā hái méi chī zǎo fàn dù zi hěn è
en: He hasn't eaten breakfast yet, and he's very hungry.
why: 还没 + verb means 'has not done it yet'. 不 would be a refusal or habit, 别 is imperative, and 没了 is not a way to negate a verb.

q: 上个月我没看___那部电影。
zh: 上个月我没看那部电影。
py: shàng ge yuè wǒ méi kàn nà bù diàn yǐng
en: I didn't see that film last month.
why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so 看 takes no 了. 没看了 is never used to mean 'did not watch'.

q: 小猫今天没吃___早饭。
zh: 小猫今天没吃早饭。
py: xiǎo māo jīn tiān méi chī zǎo fàn
en: The kitten didn't eat its breakfast today.
why: With 没 the action never happened, so there is nothing for 了 to mark as completed. 没吃了早饭 is wrong.

q: 我们昨晚没去听___音乐会，因为票卖完了。
zh: 我们昨晚没去听音乐会，因为票卖完了。
py: wǒ men zuó wǎn méi qù tīng yīn yuè huì yīn wèi piào mài wán le
en: We didn't go to the concert last night because the tickets were sold out.
why: 没去听音乐会 describes something that did not happen, so 听 takes no 了. 卖完了 at the end is a different, correct 了 for the tickets running out.

q: 弟弟没有给鱼喂___食，所以鱼都饿了。
zh: 弟弟没有给鱼喂食，所以鱼都饿了。
py: dì di méi yǒu gěi yú wèi shí suǒ yǐ yú dōu è le
en: My brother didn't feed the fish, so they're all hungry.
why: 没有 + verb cannot be followed by verbal 了. 鱼都饿了 is a correct sentence-final 了 because the fish have newly become hungry.

q: 去年冬天很冷___，河都结冰了。
zh: 去年冬天很冷，河都结冰了。
py: qù nián dōng tiān hěn lěng hé dōu jié bīng le
en: Last winter was very cold and the river froze over.
why: The first clause only describes how cold last winter was, a state with 很, so no 了. 结冰了 is a different 了 for the river's change.

q: 我觉得___那本小说很有意思。
zh: 我觉得那本小说很有意思。
py: wǒ jué de nà běn xiǎo shuō hěn yǒu yì si
en: I thought that novel was very interesting.
why: 觉得 reports an opinion and never takes 了, even when the English 'thought' is past. The tempting 觉得了 does not exist.

q: 他小时候喜欢___养鸟。
zh: 他小时候喜欢养鸟。
py: tā xiǎo shí hou xǐ huan yǎng niǎo
en: He liked keeping birds when he was little.
why: 喜欢 is a state of feeling; 小时候 already gives the past, so no 了. 喜欢了 would suggest a new liking that has just begun.

q: 上个星期天我在___公园，没在家。
zh: 上个星期天我在公园，没在家。
py: shàng ge xīng qī tiān wǒ zài gōng yuán méi zài jiā
en: Last Sunday I was at the park, not at home.
why: 在 states a location, not an action that finishes, so no 了; 上个星期天 gives the past. 在了 is never said.

q: 那只猫以前是___邻居的宠物。
zh: 那只猫以前是邻居的宠物。
py: nà zhī māo yǐ qián shì lín jū de chǒng wù
en: That cat used to be a neighbour's pet.
why: 是 is not an action that can be completed, so 是了 never means 'was'; 以前 already marks the past.

q: 她那时候有___一只很大的狗。
zh: 她那时候有一只很大的狗。
py: tā nà shí hou yǒu yī zhī hěn dà de gǒu
en: She had a very big dog back then.
why: 有 describing what she had at the time is a state, and 那时候 supplies the past, so no 了. 有了 would mean 'came to have' something new.

q: 这条路太远___，你骑车去吧。
zh: 这条路太远了，你骑车去吧。
py: zhè tiáo lù tài yuǎn le nǐ qí chē qù ba
en: This road is too far; go by bike.
why: A remark with 太 + adjective ends in 了. 的, 着 and 过 cannot close it.

q: 这部电影太长___，我看到一半就睡着了。
zh: 这部电影太长了，我看到一半就睡着了。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng tài cháng le wǒ kàn dào yī bàn jiù shuì zháo le
en: This film was so long that I fell asleep halfway through.
why: 太长 stands as a complete remark, so it takes 了 before the next clause. 着, 的 and 过 do not close a 太 + adjective.

q: 你的小狗太聪明___，什么都学得会！
zh: 你的小狗太聪明了，什么都学得会！
py: nǐ de xiǎo gǒu tài cōng ming le shén me dōu xué de huì
en: Your dog is so clever, it can learn anything!
why: The exclamation 太聪明 ends in 了. 吗 makes it a question, and 的 or 着 does not close a 太 remark.

q: 这个房间不太大___，放不下钢琴。
zh: 这个房间不太大，放不下钢琴。
py: zhè ge fáng jiān bù tài dà fàng bù xià gāng qín
en: This room isn't very big, so the piano won't fit.
why: 不太 + adjective is a plain description ('not very'), not the exclamation 太…了, so no 了 is added.

q: 这首歌非常好听___，我听了三遍。
zh: 这首歌非常好听，我听了三遍。
py: zhè shǒu gē fēi cháng hǎo tīng wǒ tīng le sān biàn
en: This song is really nice; I listened to it three times.
why: 非常 + adjective is a plain description and takes no 了; the 了 is only for 太…了. The 听了三遍 afterwards is a finished, counted action.

q: 湖边的鸟太多___，我们数不清。
zh: 湖边的鸟太多了，我们数不清。
py: hú biān de niǎo tài duō le wǒ men shǔ bù qīng
en: There are too many birds by the lake; we can't count them.
why: 太多 here is a complete remark that explains the next clause, so it ends in 了. 的, 着 and 过 do not complete it.

q: 医生说他不能喝咖啡，所以他现在___喝咖啡了。
zh: 医生说他不能喝咖啡，所以他现在不喝咖啡了。
py: yī shēng shuō tā bù néng hē kā fēi suǒ yǐ tā xiàn zài bù hē kā fēi le
en: The doctor said he can't have coffee, so he doesn't drink it any more.
why: 'No longer' is 不 + verb + 了. 没 / 没有 deny a past event and cannot be followed by this 了, and 别 is an order, not a report.

q: 我___听流行歌了，现在喜欢听古典音乐。
zh: 我不听流行歌了，现在喜欢听古典音乐。
py: wǒ bù tīng liú xíng gē le xiàn zài xǐ huan tīng gǔ diǎn yīn yuè
en: I don't listen to pop songs any more; now I like classical music.
why: A changed habit is 不 + verb + 了. 没听…了 is ungrammatical, 别 is an imperative, and 还 would say I still do it.

q: 天太黑了，我们___去森林里看鸟了。
zh: 天太黑了，我们不去森林里看鸟了。
py: tiān tài hēi le wǒ men bù qù sēn lín lǐ kàn niǎo le
en: It's too dark; we're not going to look at birds in the forest after all.
why: A changed plan is 不 + verb + 了. With the final 了, 没 and 没有 are ungrammatical, and 还没 would mean 'haven't yet'.

zh: 我昨天买了三条鱼。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le sān tiáo yú
en: I bought three fish yesterday.
why: 买了 stays together with 了 right after the verb and before the counted 三条鱼. 买三条鱼了 would misplace 了 behind a counted object.

zh: 小猫已经三个月大了。
py: xiǎo māo yǐ jīng sān ge yuè dà le
en: The kitten is already three months old.
why: 已经 comes before the age, and the sentence closes with 了 because the kitten has now reached three months.

zh: 我学了三年小提琴了。
py: wǒ xué le sān nián xiǎo tí qín le
en: I've been learning the violin for three years now.
why: Two 了: one after 学 before the duration, one at the end for 'so far, still going'. The duration comes before the object.

zh: 我们看了电影就回家。
py: wǒ men kàn le diàn yǐng jiù huí jiā
en: We'll go home as soon as we've seen the film.
why: In 'after A, then B', 了 follows the first verb before its object, then 就 introduces the second step. 看电影了就回家 would put 了 in the wrong place.

zh: 他每天晚上都遛狗。
py: tā měi tiān wǎn shang dōu liù gǒu
en: He walks the dog every evening.
why: 每天晚上 marks a habit, so the verb has no 了. The time phrase may stand before or after the subject but always before 都 and the verb.

zh: 小狗还没吃饭。
py: xiǎo gǒu hái méi chī fàn
en: The dog hasn't eaten yet.
why: 还没 goes directly before the verb and nothing follows it: no 了 is added to a negated action.

zh: 这首歌太好听了！
py: zhè shǒu gē tài hǎo tīng le
en: This song is so good!
why: 太 + adjective + 了 forms the remark. Spoken Chinese may put the topic after it (太好听了这首歌), but 了 always stays right after the adjective.

zh: 哥哥不养狗了。
py: gē ge bù yǎng gǒu le
en: My older brother doesn't keep a dog any more.
why: 'No longer' is 不 + verb phrase + 了, with 了 at the very end. 不 sits before the verb, never after.

zh: 那只鸟快要飞走了。
py: nà zhī niǎo kuài yào fēi zǒu le
en: That bird is about to fly away.
why: 快要 goes before the verb phrase and 了 closes it, since something is about to change.

zh: 我小时候很喜欢这首歌。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou hěn xǐ huan zhè shǒu gē
en: I really liked this song when I was little.
why: 很喜欢 describes a past state, so there is no 了; 我小时候 supplies the time. The object may move to the front as a topic.

zh: 他给我唱了一首歌。
py: tā gěi wǒ chàng le yī shǒu gē
en: He sang me a song.
why: One song, one finished act: 了 attaches directly to 唱, before 一首歌. 唱一首歌了 would put 了 after the counted object.

zh: 你听了这首歌就明白了。
py: nǐ tīng le zhè shǒu gē jiù míng bai le
en: Once you've heard this song you'll understand.
why: 了 follows 听, before the object, to mean 'once you've heard it'. 就 introduces the result.

zh: 我们没有看那只鸟。
py: wǒ men méi yǒu kàn nà zhī niǎo
en: We didn't look at that bird.
why: 没有 comes right before the verb, with no 了. The object may also be fronted as the topic.

zh: 她看了两个小时书了。
py: tā kàn le liǎng ge xiǎo shí shū le
en: She has been reading for two hours now.
why: 'So far, still going' takes 了 after the verb and again at the end; the duration sits between 看了 and the object.

zh: 我们不去动物园了。
py: wǒ men bù qù dòng wù yuán le
en: We're not going to the zoo after all.
why: A changed plan is 不 + verb + 了, with 了 at the end. The place may be fronted as a topic, but 了 stays last.

src_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn le nà bù diàn yǐng
zh: 我昨天没看那部电影。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi kàn nà bù diàn yǐng
en: I didn't see that film yesterday.
why: To deny a past action put 没 before the verb and drop 了. 没看了 is wrong.

src_py: wǒ xià bān rán hòu huí jiā
task: Say you go home as soon as you get off work (use 就).
zh: 我下了班就回家。
py: wǒ xià le bān jiù huí jiā
en: I go home as soon as I get off work.
why: 'As soon as A, B' uses 了 after the first verb and 就 before the second.

src_py: wǒ yǎng le sān nián māo
task: Say you have kept a cat for three years and still do.
zh: 我养了三年猫了。
py: wǒ yǎng le sān nián māo le
en: I've kept a cat for three years now.
why: For an amount that runs up to now, add a second 了 at the end.

src_py: zhè zhī māo hěn kě ài
task: Make it an exclamation with 太.
zh: 这只猫太可爱了！
py: zhè zhī māo tài kě ài le
en: This cat is so cute!
why: 太 + adjective + 了 makes the exclamation. 很 is dropped and 了 closes the remark.

task: Say you don't listen to his songs any more.
zh: 我不听他的歌了。
py: wǒ bù tīng tā de gē le
en: I don't listen to his songs any more.
why: 'Not any more' is 不 + verb + 了, with 了 at the end.

src_py: tā pāi liǎng zhāng māo de zhào piàn
zh: 她拍了两张猫的照片。
py: tā pāi le liǎng zhāng māo de zhào piàn
en: She took two photos of the cat.
why: A finished action with a counted object puts 了 right after the verb, before 两张.

task: Say he can swim now (he couldn't before).
zh: 他现在会游泳了。
py: tā xiàn zài huì yóu yǒng le
en: He can swim now.
why: A newly acquired ability ends in 了; 现在 shows the change.

zh: 小猫没吃鱼。
py: xiǎo māo méi chī yú
en: The kitten didn't eat the fish.
why: 没 + verb denies the event and 了 is removed.

src_py: nǐ xiān xǐ shǒu rán hòu chī fàn
task: Say it with 再: wash your hands before you eat.
zh: 你洗了手再吃饭。
py: nǐ xǐ le shǒu zài chī fàn
en: Wash your hands before you eat.
why: 'Do A, only then B' is 了 after the first verb and 再 before the second.

src_py: wǒ kàn wán le nà běn shū
task: Say you haven't finished it yet.
zh: 我还没看完那本书。
py: wǒ hái méi kàn wán nà běn shū
en: I haven't finished that book yet.
why: 还没 negates the completion; 了 disappears when you negate with 没.

s: 我昨天没去了公园。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù le gōng yuán
zh: 我昨天没去公园。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù gōng yuán
en: I didn't go to the park yesterday.
why: 没 already says it did not happen, so 了 cannot be added after the verb.

s: 他以前是了一个音乐老师。
s_py: tā yǐ qián shì le yī ge yīn yuè lǎo shī
zh: 他以前是一个音乐老师。
py: tā yǐ qián shì yī ge yīn yuè lǎo shī
en: He used to be a music teacher.
why: 是 is not an action that can be completed, so 是了 never means 'was'. 以前 already carries the past.

s: 爸爸以前经常带了我去河边钓鱼。
s_py: bà ba yǐ qián jīng cháng dài le wǒ qù hé biān diào yú
zh: 爸爸以前经常带我去河边钓鱼。
py: bà ba yǐ qián jīng cháng dài wǒ qù hé biān diào yú
en: Dad often took me fishing by the river in the past.
why: 经常 marks a repeated habit, so 带 takes no 了, even though it is about the past.

s: 这只鸟太了漂亮。
s_py: zhè zhī niǎo tài le piào liang
zh: 这只鸟太漂亮了。
py: zhè zhī niǎo tài piào liang le
en: This bird is so beautiful!
why: In 太…了, the 了 closes the remark after the adjective; it cannot sit between 太 and the adjective.

s: 我们不看了电影。
s_py: wǒ men bù kàn le diàn yǐng
zh: 我们不看电影了。
py: wǒ men bù kàn diàn yǐng le
en: We're not going to watch the film after all.
why: 'Not any more / after all' puts 了 at the end of the sentence, not after the verb.

s: 我昨天看三部电影。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn sān bù diàn yǐng
zh: 我昨天看了三部电影。
py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn le sān bù diàn yǐng
en: I watched three films yesterday.
why: A finished event with a counted object needs 了 right after the verb. 昨天 alone does not mark the action as done.

s: 我觉得了这首歌很好听。
s_py: wǒ jué de le zhè shǒu gē hěn hǎo tīng
zh: 我觉得这首歌很好听。
py: wǒ jué de zhè shǒu gē hěn hǎo tīng
en: I thought this song sounded good.
why: 觉得 reports an opinion and takes no 了; 觉得了 is not Chinese.

s: 昨天下午我在了动物园。
s_py: zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ zài le dòng wù yuán
zh: 昨天下午我在动物园。
py: zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ zài dòng wù yuán
en: I was at the zoo yesterday afternoon.
why: 在 marks location, not a completed action, so it takes no 了; 昨天下午 shows the past.

s: 他没听了那首歌。
s_py: tā méi tīng le nà shǒu gē
zh: 他没听那首歌。
py: tā méi tīng nà shǒu gē
en: He didn't listen to that song.
why: 没 negates the whole event, so 听 takes no 了.

s: 明天你吃了早饭就带小狗去散步吧。
s_py: míng tiān nǐ chī le zǎo fàn jiù dài xiǎo gǒu qù sàn bù ba
zh: 明天你吃了早饭就带小狗去散步吧。
py: míng tiān nǐ chī le zǎo fàn jiù dài xiǎo gǒu qù sàn bù ba
en: Tomorrow, take the dog for a walk as soon as you've had breakfast.
why: 了 after 吃 means 'once you've eaten', and it is correct even though the plan is for tomorrow.

s: 天快黑了，小鸟都飞回去了。
s_py: tiān kuài hēi le xiǎo niǎo dōu fēi huí qù le
zh: 天快黑了，小鸟都飞回去了。
py: tiān kuài hēi le xiǎo niǎo dōu fēi huí qù le
en: It's getting dark and the little birds have all flown back.
why: 快…了 for what is about to happen, and a final 了 for the completed flying back; both are correct.

s: 我三天没听音乐了，真想听歌。
s_py: wǒ sān tiān méi tīng yīn yuè le zhēn xiǎng tīng gē
zh: 我三天没听音乐了，真想听歌。
py: wǒ sān tiān méi tīng yīn yuè le zhēn xiǎng tīng gē
en: I haven't listened to music for three days and I really want to.
why: Time span + 没 + verb + 了 means 'haven't … for …'. This is a separate pattern, not a negated 了 sentence.

s: 以前我每天都去河边喂鸭子。
s_py: yǐ qián wǒ měi tiān dōu qù hé biān wèi yā zi
zh: 以前我每天都去河边喂鸭子。
py: yǐ qián wǒ měi tiān dōu qù hé biān wèi yā zi
en: I used to feed the ducks by the river every day.
why: A past habit with 每天都 takes no 了, so the sentence is correct as written.

s: 我小时候很怕狗。
s_py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou hěn pà gǒu
zh: 我小时候很怕狗。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou hěn pà gǒu
en: I was very afraid of dogs when I was little.
why: A past state with 很 + feeling verb needs no 了; 小时候 gives the time.

s: 太好了，我们找到小猫了！
s_py: tài hǎo le wǒ men zhǎo dào xiǎo māo le
zh: 太好了，我们找到小猫了！
py: tài hǎo le wǒ men zhǎo dào xiǎo māo le
en: Great, we found the kitten!
why: 太好了 is the 太…了 remark and 找到小猫了 is a completed result, so both 了 are right.

s: 他已经看了三遍这部电影了，还想再看。
s_py: tā yǐ jīng kàn le sān biàn zhè bù diàn yǐng le hái xiǎng zài kàn
zh: 他已经看了三遍这部电影了，还想再看。
py: tā yǐ jīng kàn le sān biàn zhè bù diàn yǐng le hái xiǎng zài kàn
en: He has already seen this film three times and wants to see it again.
why: 已经 with a count 'so far' takes two 了, and 还想再看 confirms it is still going on.

s: 我没有钱了，不能再买书了。
s_py: wǒ méi yǒu qián le bù néng zài mǎi shū le
zh: 我没有钱了，不能再买书了。
py: wǒ méi yǒu qián le bù néng zài mǎi shū le
en: I've run out of money and can't buy any more books.
why: 没有 + noun + 了 means 'none left', and 不能再…了 means 'can't any more'. Both are standard patterns.

s: 她唱了两个小时的歌，现在很累。
s_py: tā chàng le liǎng ge xiǎo shí de gē xiàn zài hěn lèi
zh: 她唱了两个小时的歌，现在很累。
py: tā chàng le liǎng ge xiǎo shí de gē xiàn zài hěn lèi
en: She sang for two hours and is tired now.
why: A finished, timed action takes 了 after the verb, before the duration. 现在很累 is a plain state.

s: 昨天的电影不太好看。
s_py: zuó tiān de diàn yǐng bù tài hǎo kàn
zh: 昨天的电影不太好看。
py: zuó tiān de diàn yǐng bù tài hǎo kàn
en: Yesterday's film wasn't very good.
why: 不太 + adjective describes a state, so there is no 了, even for yesterday.

s: 他昨天没来上课，因为他病了。
s_py: tā zuó tiān méi lái shàng kè yīn wèi tā bìng le
zh: 他昨天没来上课，因为他病了。
py: tā zuó tiān méi lái shàng kè yīn wèi tā bìng le
en: He didn't come to class yesterday because he was ill.
why: 没来上课 takes no 了. 病了 is a different, correct 了 for the new state of being ill.
